title: Run Ledger Row
description: One append-only row in <project>/.harness/runs.jsonl (the harness black box). When no project root is detected the row is appended to ~/.claude/state/run-ledger.jsonl instead. Records what a substantial turn actually did — tools, agents, files touched — joined with git context, so multi-step work leaves a resumable audit trail without relying on the model to write one. Written by the ledger-autolog Stop hook via orchestrator-runtime/shared/run-ledger.js appendRun. This is the MACHINE layer of CLAUDE.global.md 0.7; the human-readable semantic ledger is .goals/LEDGER.md via /ledger. Required fields are minimal so a shell caller can write a row; additionalProperties:true so callers can extend.

run_id.description: Stable id for this run (generated from ts when the caller supplies none)

subsystem.description: session = per-turn autolog row; harness = a maintenance/tooling run

git_dirty.description: true if working tree had uncommitted changes

files_changed.description: Paths written this turn (Edit / Write / MultiEdit / NotebookEdit)

edit_count.description: Number of distinct files written this turn

evidence_refs.description: Pointers to detailed artifacts produced elsewhere (this ledger does not duplicate them)

human_approvals.description: Approval text the user gave before execution (CLAUDE.global.md 0.6 plan-card 坎)

decision.description: RECORDED = a plain run row (no verdict); the rest are available to callers that do reach a pass/fail conclusion

rollback_ref.description: Backup dir / commit to roll back to
